title: Meal Pattern Analysis in CLAMS
author: Trina Knotts
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yrwfv7e

steps.title: Pre-Study Acclimation
steps.instruction: Acclimate animals in MBP Vivarium Room 115 for one week prior to the study.

substeps.instruction: Place animals in single housing (duplex cages with a clear divider).
Introduce sifted powdered version of normal rodent chow via specialized plastic feeders in home cages (in addition to pelleted chow) 2 days before transferring to CLAMS acclimation cages.
Provide de-ionized water with mineral content of ~400 PPM (add 6-7 mineral drops per 1L of de-ionized water; verify 400-425 PPM via conductivity meter).
Grossly observe and document powdered food and water intake on the Weight/Food/Water Intake Log sheet.

steps.title: CLAMS Room Acclimation
steps.instruction: Acclimate animals in CLAMS room cages for 24 hours, maintaining a room temperature of 24°C and a 12-hour light/dark cycle (lights off 18:00, on 06:00; 100-200 lux inside cages).

substeps.instruction: Fill feeders to capacity with powdered feed before 12:00; ensure food guard size matches animal size to prevent foraging.
Weigh mice and record weights on the Weight/Food/Water intake log sheet.
Fill Lixit bottles with de-ionized water (400-425 PPM mineral content) and place in cage slots.
Supply power to fans for air circulation, tighten lids, and attach cage cards.
Record the time animals were placed in cages in the Animal and System Monitoring Log sheet.
Post a 'Testing in Progress' sign on the door and fill out the Animal Monitoring Log Sheet daily.
After 24 hours, weigh animals and document food/water intake. Monitor for weight loss; animals losing 10-15% of body weight must be assessed for feasibility or removed from the study.

steps.title: CLAMS Incubator Setup and Initiation
steps.instruction: Initiate 24-hour incubator acclimation in the AM (before 12:00).

substeps.instruction: Perform computer set-up and check hardware (Drierite, soda lime, ammonia filter).
Prepare 2L of de-ionized water by adding mineral drops (67 drops/L) to achieve 400-425 PPM; fill two 1L bottles and record mineral content in the Animal and System Monitoring Log sheet.
Fill water lines using the 'pump status' option in Oxymax software.
Calibrate gases using 20% CO2, Nitrogen balance.
Place mesh food holders with food on balances in the CLAMS apparatus; turn on and tare balances to 0 grams.
Weigh animals and record on data sheet.
Place acclimation cages into the incubator and secure lids.
Set incubator temperature to 22°C and lights (on 06:00, off 18:00; 100-200 lux). Do not use door panels.

steps.title: Experimental Run and Monitoring
steps.instruction: Run the experiment in Oxymax and monitor animals for the duration of the study (24h acclimation followed by 48h or more of testing).

substeps.instruction: Start recording via Experiment → Run in Oxymax.
Check RER measurements hourly (RER < 0.7 or > 1.3 may indicate leaks).
Monitor mice via CLAX program every two hours (08:00-17:00 Mon-Fri) and remotely between 21:00-22:00.
Visually check animals before 10:00 and 16:00; document food/water intake, activity, RER, and environmental conditions in the Animal and System Remote Monitoring Log sheet.
In case of temperature failure (outside 15-30°C range) or power outage exceeding 30 minutes, remove animals and return to home cages.

steps.title: Study Termination and Cleanup
steps.instruction: End the study and perform post-analysis procedures.

substeps.instruction: Stop recording via Experiment → Stop in Oxymax.
Weigh animals and return them to home cages.
Determine body composition via DEXA immediately following CLAMS analysis.
Wash and disinfect CLAMS cages; flush water lines with 10% bleach and rinse with de-ionized water.

steps.title: Data Collection and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Extract and process meal pattern data.

substeps.instruction: Generate food bout 'B' .csv files from .CDTA files using Oxymax software.

Combine .csv files into a data folder and run the custom MS Excel-based (Visual basic) macro to calculate parameters (e.g., Avg Meal Duration, Avg Meal Size, # of Meals, IMI, Satiety Ratio, Eating Rate, etc.).
Scan food bout files for irregularities such as 'overload'.
Verify that 'Feed Accumulated (Feed Acc. 1)' contains no 'underload', 'overload', or 'No response' messages.
